discovery_notes: Cell B096 licensed Star Wars/Marvel sweep (2015-2026, focus 2018-2019). 28 standard searches, snippets only, mostly Disney Pins Blog plus BoxLunch/Hot Topic/Loungefly listings. 2018 yielded nothing; 2019 adds Wicket, SW Planets LE, Rise of Skywalker, Sith, Infinity Gauntlet, Marvel 80th, LA Comic Con Funko, FiGPiN. 2020-2023 Loungefly/Funko Marvel and SW sets added where members were named. Hot Topic Captain Marvel set members not found. Retailer-only keys where maker unstated. Resellers, Walmart, fandom wiki not used for claims.
